validate_events_dataframe: validate a pandas DataFrame of events checking type columns and sorting by timeline and start time
create_segment_subsegment: create a subsegment from an existing Segment by specifying a relative start offset and duration
iterate_segments_from_events: iterate over strided time windows of 149 seconds to yield Segment objects from an events DataFrame
find_enclosed_events: find all events fully enclosed within a given start time and duration window in a DataFrame
select_segment_with_creator: use SegmentCreator to select overlapping events for a given start and duration and return a Segment
